blocks.text: There will be no data centers to be put up in the proposed Pax Silica hub in Clark. This came straight from the horse’s mouth, as President Marcos finally spoke on the mounting protests against the United States-led technology and critical mineral supply chain initiative. Speaking in Shenzhen, China, where he attended the Asia-Pacific Economic Forum along with US President Donald Trump and other world leaders, the President said he was “a little bit perplexed” by the protest rallies “because number one, there is no deal yet.” “I hear voices [saying] that it will be environmentally damaging.
